about: A story editor's answer sheet for the dev set (The Weighhouse: Under the Line, Ch 1 and Ch 2). What a careful human editor would put in the story bible after reading both chapters. Scored by scripts/canon-score.js; docs/semantics/READING.md. Every quote is verbatim in the chapter named. weight: must / should / nice. hard: a trait the deterministic slip rules own (sex, eyes, hair colour, species). said: true only in speech, never a fact of the world. also: other quotes that support the same fact equally well. traps: claims a reader is likely to make that the text does not support; a produced fact matching one is wrong.
